title: Hearing on support and programs for LGBTQ+ veterans
summary: The Council's Committee on Veterans held an oversight hearing on services for LGBTQ+ veterans, alongside two bills. Int. 914 would require a one-year study on the feasibility of a pilot program offering reconsolidation of traumatic memories therapy to veterans in the city. Int. 928 would create an LGBTQ liaison within the Department of Veterans' Services to conduct outreach, help with discharge upgrades and connect veterans to services, with annual public reporting starting July 31, 2027.
